title: Enchantmented Golden apple recipe
description: Tired of mods only being on the version that you server is not on when you have a aternos server. Instad of this being a mod that's only one version this is a datapack that works on almost all versions.
body: This datapack brings back the old enchanted golden apple recipe (for severs only). So you used to craft the enchanted golden apple with 8 Gold blocks and 1 apple. They removed it because "it was deemed to op". But i added it back with the same recipe. Idk if it works on different verisons other than 1.19.2 so yeah if you want to figure out if it works try it out. Anyways. Bye
